segments.sn33.6-10:1.2: Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho vacchagotto paribbājako bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn33.6-10:1.3: “ko nu kho, bho gotama, hetu, ko paccayo, yānimāni anekavihitāni diṭṭhigatāni loke uppajjanti –
segments.sn33.6-10:1.4: sassato lokoti vā, asassato lokoti vā … pe …
segments.sn33.6-10:1.5: neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇāti vā”ti?
segments.sn33.6-10:1.11: viññāṇe kho, vaccha, adassanā … pe … viññāṇanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya adassanā … pe ….
